name: ENS160
tips: status() is 0 when readings are valid, 1 during the ~3 min warm-up after each power-up, 2 during the first 24 h of the sensor's life.
Feed it the real air temperature and humidity with set_compensation() (e.g. from the AHT21 on combo boards) for better accuracy.
Common ENS160+AHT21 boards put both chips on the same I2C bus: declare an AHT20 next to it.
